BiblicalUsage: Zetham is a Levite of Gershon's line, and Scripture lists him two ways: as the son of Jehiel, who kept the treasures of the house of God, and as a son of Laadan in the divisions of the Levites. The two listings may be one man named by father and by grandfather, or two men of the same name — the text does not settle it. Their full stories live on their People profiles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the treasury keepers mattered: God trusted ordinary Levites with the holy things, and their names were written down.
RelatedPeople: Zetham, Son of Jehiel; Zetham, Son of Laadan
